notes: Optional regression floors in milliseconds per run, keyed by harness case id. Null means no floor: the case is MEASURED and does not fail the campaign. Ratify a number only after at least three clean published campaigns for the same host and case. Do not rewrite older campaign JSON when a floor changes. The publish gate allowlist is rand-m5 plus allowed_hosts. SC_BENCH_GATE_ALLOW_ANY_HOST=1 bypasses that check for local development only.
